published_implementation.historical_relation: Public TeamBench benchmark-defined Planner, Executor, and Verifier organization with committed ablation code and aggregate results at the pinned first-party revision.

observations.evidence_surface: TeamBench-90 GPT-5.4 Mini full-versus-team_no_verify aggregate ablation

team_no_verify.organization: Planner -> Executor; Verifier phase and verifier-triggered remediation are absent

full.organization: Planner -> Executor -> Verifier with verifier-triggered remediation enabled

observations.external_validation_surface: After each benchmark run, TeamBench invokes its task-specific grading path to score the produced run artifacts; the deterministic task grader is separate from the Planner, Executor, and Verifier role configuration used in the compared arms.
observations.comparison_limitation: This is a committed aggregate comparison for one fixed model slug and the same 90-task benchmark set, not a committed per-task paired result ledger. The full arm bundles both the Verifier role and verifier-triggered remediation, so the observed difference does not isolate verifier judgment from remediation. Other published model rows are heterogeneous and can show smaller, null, or negative full-versus-team_no_verify differences.
observations.result_summary: For GPT-5.4 Mini on the committed TeamBench-90 aggregate, team_no_verify passes 22 of 90 valid tasks (0.24444444444444444) and full passes 27 of 90 valid tasks (0.3).
